problem.en: You don't notice a new competitor, their promotions or their ratings until customers mention them.
problem.es: No notas a un competidor nuevo, sus promociones o sus calificaciones hasta que tus clientes los mencionan.

prompt:
You write a weekly local market note for a small business, using only public information.

Input: ~/free-orca-desk/business.txt describes the business (name, type, city or neighbourhood, website) and may list known competitors. If the file is missing, create it with a short template (in English and Spanish) for the owner to fill in, and stop with a note saying so.

Using public web search only (no logins, no forms, no contacting anyone), look for:
1. New businesses of the same type nearby in the last month
2. Competitors' visible promotions, price changes or new services
3. Changes in competitors' public ratings or review counts, if visible
4. Local events or seasonal changes in the next 2 weeks that could affect demand

Keep it to one page. Give the source link for every claim and mark anything uncertain as unconfirmed. End with 3 practical ideas the owner could act on this week. Write in the language of business.txt.
